violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §747.2103(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods
violation_type.typical_finding: Children were observed sitting for a long period between outdoor time and lunch time.

finding_variants.text: Children were observed sitting for a long period between outdoor time and lunch time.

Children were observed to be made to sit after breakfast for an extended period of time buckled into feeding chairs.  The children were removed from the chairs and allowed to move freely during the inspection.

Children were observed waiting for an extended period during the transition between activities. This was addressed during the inspection when I intervened, explained the issue, and the caregiver removed the child.
